mechanism: Rifampin is a potent CYP3A4 inducer that dramatically increases ritonavir metabolism, reducing plasma concentrations of ritonavir to subtherapeutic levels and compromising HIV protease inhibition.
action: Avoid concomitant use; rifampin is contraindicated with ritonavir-boosted regimens due to loss of antiretroviral efficacy and risk of treatment failure and resistance development.
